caption:
In an open grassy clearing, a man in a dark green leather jacket stands at the left of the frame, his right eye swollen and bruised, gaze fixed right. A vertical pole marks the right edge. A second man, in a light gray jacket stained red across the chest and a small bandage on his forehead, steps into view from the right and faces him. The two hold their positions, looking at one another against the tall green grass.

The man in the leather jacket raises a clenched hand to his mouth and nose, holding it there for several moments before lowering it again. He then turns and moves across the foreground, his back and head growing larger until they partly block the second man from view. As this happens, the man in the gray jacket lifts one arm toward a green mesh structure at the lower left. The framing shifts throughout, the right-edge pole sliding out of view while the grassy background pans slowly behind the two figures.
